q: Can mangrove planting earn CCTS credits under methodology BM FR05.001?
title: Mangrove planting under BM FR05.001
short: Yes, if the land is degraded mangrove habitat. BM FR05.001 needs more than 90 per cent of the project area planted with mangrove species, soil disturbance on no more than 10 per cent of the area, and no change to the hydrology of connected wetlands if other species are planted.
audience: Coastal states, CSR teams and forestry developers

ul: More than 90 per cent of the area is planted with mangrove species. If over 10 per cent is non-mangrove, the project must not alter the hydrology of the area or of connected wetlands up- and down-gradient.
Soil disturbance from the project covers no more than 10 per cent of the area.
The applicability conditions of the forestry tools used also apply.
Adapted from UNFCCC CDM methodology AR-AM0014 (version valid from 4 October 2013).
Forestry credits are issued as temporary or long-term credits; long-term ones expire at the end of the crediting period, as the methodology sets out.

senseible: Senseible does not measure forest carbon stocks.
